_comment: Default sdlc.json ciCommands per stack: what each job of templates/ci/github-actions.yml runs from the repo root. Filled from e2e-test-run/references/suite-speed-and-reliability.md section K. {shard} and {total} in e2e, {files} in e2eTouched. install may be empty. Set a step the repo does not have to true.

typescript.lint: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck
typescript.e2e: pnpm exec playwright install --with-deps chromium && pnpm exec playwright test --shard={shard}/{total}
typescript.e2eTouched: pnpm exec playwright install --with-deps chromium && pnpm exec playwright test {files}

python.lint: uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && uv run mypy src

rails.e2e: RAILS_ENV=test bin/rails assets:precompile && bundle exec parallel_tests spec/system --only-group {shard} --group-by runtime -n {total} --type rspec
rails.e2eTouched: RAILS_ENV=test bin/rails assets:precompile && bundle exec rspec {files}
